'''Abbeth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] as a member of [[Havoc Squad]], an elite unit in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]. He served under [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Aric Jorgan]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and participated in Jorgan's guerrilla war against [[Zakuul]] after they went rogue.<ref name="KOTFE" />
